looks.name: Coloured pencil

looks.name: Watercolour
looks.note: Clear washes bleeding into soft edges, like a picture book

looks.name: Ink wash
looks.note: Dark ink for the rocks, pale washes for the sea mist, the bare paper for sky

looks.name: Realistic
looks.note: Light and texture as in a photograph, every stone in its place

looks.name: Crayon
looks.note: Thick lines and bold colour, the sun and the gulls as a child draws them

looks.name: Textbook
looks.note: Even lines and quiet colour, clarity first

looks.name: Flat
looks.note: Geometric shapes with no outlines, made for infographics

brief.subject: The same lighthouse
brief.intent: How far a picture's feeling moves when only its style changes
brief.audience: Someone choosing a style for their own picture
brief.concept: The same headland and lighthouse in seven styles, switched in place; under the picture what each style is like, and the colours and type it brings with it — a style is not a filter but a whole way of seeing
brief.direction: White paper and fine lines, the picture hung like a print, the eye left on it
